# Twisted Pin

> Plainfield's premier night out. Bowling optional. Cocktails curated by Brian Van Flandern, America's Top Mixologist (Food Network), a 28-tap self-serve beer and wine wall, food built to share, 17 traditional lanes and a semi-private VIP suite. Adults-first and family-welcome.

Twisted Pin is at 15610 Joliet Rd, Plainfield, IL 60544. Visit for drinks, food, bowling and games. See the FAQ for practical venue policies.

## Explore

- [Bar](https://www.twistedpin.com/bar/): Cocktail program and self-serve beer and wine wall.
- [Food](https://www.twistedpin.com/eat/): From-scratch food built to share.
- [Bowling](https://www.twistedpin.com/bowl/): 17 traditional lanes plus a semi-private VIP suite.
- [VIP suite](https://www.twistedpin.com/vip-suite/): A semi-private VIP suite set apart from the traditional lanes. Reserve part of the suite, or ask to reserve the whole suite; other groups may share the suite unless your booking reserves the whole suite. When your booking reserves the whole suite, it is yours during your event time. Share your headcount and occasion with the event team to discuss the right setup.
- [Arcade](https://www.twistedpin.com/game/): Games and redemption prizes.
- [Events](https://www.twistedpin.com/events/): Current group-event options and planning.
